extracted.name: Patricia's Green Chile Soup
extracted.description: Patricia's green chili soup recipe makes a hearty, spicy meal made with simple refrigerator and pantry staples — it's sure to become a dinner favorite.
ingredient_lines: 0.5 cup chopped fresh green chile peppers
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat. Sauté onion and garlic until translucent, 3 to 4 minutes. Add chicken, chiles, and cumin.
Cook until flavors are blended, about 1 minute. Stir in soup, and half-and-half until well combined. Continue to cook until heated through, about 5 minutes.
Ladle soup into bowls; top with cheese, and a dollop of sour cream.
